input.expression: CASE WHEN d.icd10 ~ '^[A-Z][0-9]{3}$' THEN substr(d.icd10, 1, 3) || '.' || substr(d.icd10, 4) ELSE d.icd10 END
input.rationale: Some ICD-10 codes are recorded without the dot (J189, E119, D649, J069, A150) while the vocabulary stores J18.9 etc.; re-insert the dot after the third character before the lookup.

final_text: condition_concept_id was 0 for about 13% of records. Every unmapped code was a valid ICD-10 code written without its dot (J069, J189, D649, E119, A150; no rarer codes were withheld); the vocabulary stores them as J06.9, J18.9, ... (it has J18.9 and E11.9 but not J189 or E119). I normalised the code in the lookup expression for both condition_concept_id and condition_source_concept_id. condition_source_value keeps the code exactly as recorded.
